_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for the payment link. Set STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK to the full Stripe Payment Link URL (https://buy.stripe.com/...). Leave it as an empty string until the link exists. Rebuild with python3 scripts/build.py after changing this file. ORDER_FORM_ENDPOINT is optional; when empty, the order form opens a mailto to CONTACT_EMAIL. Do not put secret keys here. A Payment Link URL is public.
